name: 07405 · Kinnelon, NJ
findings: ZIP 07405 (Kinnelon) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07405 (Kinnelon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07405 (Kinnelon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
